newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nissan sells luxury cars in Middle East.
newsitem.headline: Nissan sells luxury cars in Middle East.

text.p: Nissan Motor Co Ltd said on Thursday it has started selling its Gloria and Infiniti Q45 luxury sedans in the Middle East.
Nissan hopes to sell 1,000 units of each model annually.
Nissan now sells mid-class and compact cars, pickup trucks and sport-utility vehicles in the area.

Its vehicle exports to the Middle East rose a steep 56.6 percent from a year earlier to 24,900 units in April to September period, helped by the weaker yen, after it had a 4.1 percent decline in the full year to March 1996 due to strong yen.
Overall vehicle shipment to the Middle East area by Japanese carmakers rose 78 percent from a year earlier to about 93,000 in April to September, due to the weaker yen.
Luxury cars like Mercedes-Benz, Porsche and BMW, dominate the Middle East market.
